text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of features described as user stories. Every day, team members have short meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work often, get feedback, and make improvements quickly. As a result, Agile helps teams respond to change and deliver value to customers faster.
